candidate: H35a shared rank-36 bilateral task-atom transport fit-all capacity discriminator
purpose: Test whether a one-percent shared off-diagonal left/right low-rank transport around a basis-free task-gradient atom can fit the six known leading-PC parts before spending compute on leave-one-node-out transfer.

task_atom.formula: D_n(E) = NS5(gradient of fixed task loss with respect to W_n at W0)

fit.target: six-node leading PC of the centered registered 239-state trajectory
fit.normalization: unit Frobenius norm independently for every task atom and PC part
fit.algorithm: 128 deterministic full-batch Adam iterations minimizing average unit-target squared error
fit.factor_initialization: independent normal with standard deviation inverse square root of the corresponding channel dimension

routing_after_pass: Write and preregister H35b using the identical rank, prompt, initialization, optimizer, and state for six-fold leave-one-node-out transfer.
routing_after_failure: Close the exact rank-36 bilateral task-atom family and move to the next theory-authorized construction without a sweep.
forbidden_followups: iteration, learning-rate, seed, or initialization sweep
